message:
The other day, we were chatting with friends about our family go-bags. You know, the bags we put together a while back filled with essentials for any unexpected event. One friend laughed and said, ‘I thought you were just being paranoid!’

Well, wouldn’t you know it, a few days later, they had a minor emergency at home, and guess who was the one pulling out their own go-bag? 😄 It was a gentle reminder that preparedness doesn’t mean we’re overly cautious — it just means we’re ready for whatever life throws our way.

Have you ever had a moment like this? We’d love to hear your stories or tips on staying prepared!
